title: Decode: KDA core (FP32 state)
shape: NVFP4 1-node D3-32 DP-rank slice (L24 view), r24 (384 verify rows), u132k, k=3; ms per decode step
basis: MEASURED in-step (Rhea 1-node profile, 93-layer projection, perf-model/microbench/results/rhea1n_d3x32). current_ms stays the production dispatch (KdaWS + flush) until KdaFlow beats it; KdaFlow progress is microbench (1 GPU, n96 = r24, 69 layers in one CUDA graph, deferred fold active): 64.6 us/layer
gap_analysis: MEASURED (1-GPU microbench, D3-32 per-GPU shape, 69 layers / CUDA graph, deferred fold with 1..4 pending tokens, us/layer): KdaFlow v8 n32/64/96/128 = 21.8/38.9/53.6/71.0 vs model 8.76/17.5/26.3/35 (x2.0-2.5). Per group-item at n96 (2 groups of 4 warps, 255 regs): prep 5K, fold+checkpoint 4K, verify 7.4K, epilogue 1.7K cycles -> ~9K cycles per item per SM vs the ~5K memory budget. Instruction stream is lean (SASS histogram: ~3.4K instr/item/thread, FP2 43%) and smem-path traffic ~3K cycles/item; the remaining gap is latency: prep and epilogue (MUFU, barriers, reductions) run on the same warps as the FP32 passes, and only 2 warps per SMSP fit (128 state registers per thread). Memory skeleton alone (no compute) 36.7 us at n96 because pages land early and wait for a free group.
inefficiencies: MEASURED: prep (conv/norm/decay/fold operands) ~5K cycles per item on the scan warps; not overlapped within a group
MEASURED: verify ~7.4K cycles/item for 1024 FP2 per thread (2K pipe cycles): per-token chain decay pass -> 8-lane butterfly -> correction broadcast via smem -> update pass
MEASURED: setmaxnreg does not give a third (prep) warpgroup without the scan losing its registers: ptxas compiles at the 168-register launch cap (v9 verify 11-14K cycles/item)
MEASURED: in-step baseline slice likely has no pending RecoverSSM commits (no flush kernel in its profile): not production-representative for KDA
rubin_features: two-die locality domains: per-4 KiB page home die (default interleave) + %smid -> die map (dies.py)
bulk async copies (TMA) into a multi-stage shared-memory ring
